title: Haran
summary: Raleigh names Haran in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The son of Terah, and the father of Lot, Sarah, and Milcah. The city is the location haran. Passages that name the son were attached. Passages that name only the city were not. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter I, §. II, sig. 158a
